entities.summary: William Henry Boyce, was an American lawyer and politician from Georgetown, in Sussex County, Delaware, and later from Dover, in Kent County, Delaware. He was a member of the Democratic Party, and served as Associate Justice of the Delaware Superior Court and U.S. Representative from Delaware.
